notes: Multnomah County cast vote record cvr-councilor-district-3.csv. Ballot allowed 6 ranks. Cleanup follows Portland City Code 2.08 (see data/portland/README.md). Ballots with an overvote: 943; with a skipped rank: 883; with a repeated candidate: 601; remade ballots: 3948. Blank: 12889 with no marks (estimated from precinct styles), 545 with only overvoted ranks. 'Uncertified Write In' stands for all write-ins for people not on the City's certified write-in list, combined; the official count treats it as one candidate.
